Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.

Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1170-2350-2921-5131--202.description:

Repeat.

1643-2073-5226-7878.description:

When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Clown Car.

Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

372-2781-3378.manaNeeded: {7}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2781-3378.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

232-4365-5778-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Priest of Urabrask that are 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask tokens enter, they each trigger, adding six {R}.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Appa trigger, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Appa that are 1/1.
Put both Appa tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Appa tokens' enter-the-battlefield ability trigger, airbending Appa with one trigger and nothing with the other.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 7.
232-4365-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

1170-1812-2440-7528.description:
Cast the copy of Awaken the Ages from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Strife Scholar, which enters prepared.
When Strife Scholar enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
When the tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers for each of them, adding a total of at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {R} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding nine {C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 7 any number of times.

Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

2713-3094-4659-4742-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-4742-7344.description:

Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

813-2104-7339.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.

When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Flicker, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Dualcaster Mage.

Resolve the Whip Silk spell.

You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.

2511-5972-6054.description:

When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

1029-5028-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.

Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.

1029-5028-5711.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.

Repeat, tapping the Skullwinder and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.

Gain life.

Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Lagrella and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Patron of the Orochi.
